# Social Media Posts

Social media posts: design a post with your message on it, a square feed post, a tall story or a pin, for an announcement, a quote, a sale or a tip.

## What it does
Give the message, the details and the format. Claude tells you the price and designs the post.

**How the files are made:** each social media post is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

The lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install social-media-posts@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Social Media Posts talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/social-post/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each social media post uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The social media posts show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_social_post_models` | Models for social media posts with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_social_post_cost` | Exact price of one social media post before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_social_post` | Starts one social media post in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_social_post` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make an Instagram post that says Grand opening this Saturday"
- "Design a story announcing our summer sale, 30% off"
- "Create a quote post with Small steps every day"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the social media post (the message, details, theme and style) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
